Opening paragraph: what the phenomenon is and why it is worth playing with.
Everything runs in your browser and updates while you move the sliders.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// shared helpers: one persistent canvas per explorable, page-sized fonts, responsive width
exFont = ({size: getComputedStyle(document.body).fontSize, family: getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily, toString() { return this.size + " " + this.family; }})
exFg = () => getComputedStyle(document.body).color
mkCanvas = (W, H) => {
  const c = DOM.context2d(W, H);
  c.canvas.style.width = "100%"; c.canvas.style.maxWidth = W + "px"; c.canvas.style.height = "auto";
  return c;
}
axisBox = (c, x, y, w, h) => { c.strokeStyle = "#999"; c.lineWidth = 1; c.strokeRect(x, y, w, h); }
```

## The model

State the equations and say in words what each symbol means.

$$\tau \frac{dx}{dt} = -x + a$$

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Controls. Prefix names with a short tag unique to this page (here "tp") so that
// nothing clashes if cells are ever copied between pages.
viewof tpA = Inputs.range([0, 2], {value: 1, step: 0.05, label: "a"})
viewof tpTau = Inputs.range([1, 50], {value: 10, step: 1, label: "τ"})
viewof tpPause = Inputs.toggle({label: "Pause"})
viewof tpReset = Inputs.button("Reset")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Simulation. A generator cell yields the state on every animation frame.
// Read slider values through viewof X.value inside the loop so that changing a
// slider does not restart the simulation; reference a cell directly (like tpReset)
// if you do want a change to restart it.
tpState = {
  tpReset;
  const dt = 0.1, win = 300, n = Math.round(win / dt);
  const trace = new Float32Array(n);
  let x = 0, t = 0;
  while (true) {
    if (!viewof tpPause.value) {
      const a = viewof tpA.value, tau = viewof tpTau.value;
      for (let s = 0; s < 10; s++) {
        x += dt / tau * (-x + a);
        trace.copyWithin(0, 1); trace[n - 1] = x;
        t += dt;
      }
    }
    yield {trace, t, x};
  }
}
tpCanvas = mkCanvas(760, 300)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Drawing. Clear the persistent canvas and redraw from the current state.
{
  const {trace, t} = tpState, c = tpCanvas, fg = exFg(), W = 760, H = 300;
  c.clearRect(0, 0, W, H); c.font = exFont;
  const P = {x0: 80, y0: 12, w: W - 100, h: 240}, ymax = 2.2;
  const sx = i => P.x0 + P.w * i / (trace.length - 1), sy = v => P.y0 + P.h * (1 - v / ymax);
  axisBox(c, P.x0, P.y0, P.w, P.h);
  c.strokeStyle = "#1f77b4"; c.lineWidth = 2; c.beginPath();
  trace.forEach((v, i) => i ? c.lineTo(sx(i), sy(v)) : c.moveTo(sx(i), sy(v)));
  c.stroke();
  c.fillStyle = fg; c.textAlign = "center"; c.fillText(`last 300 time units · t = ${t.toFixed(0)}`, P.x0 + P.w / 2, P.y0 + P.h + 24);
  c.textAlign = "right"; c.fillText("x", P.x0 - 10, P.y0 + P.h / 2 + 5); c.fillText("0", P.x0 - 8, sy(0) + 5); c.fillText(ymax, P.x0 - 8, sy(ymax) + 5);
  return c.canvas;
}
```
